report.summary: The change adds one info log in artifactToken after a token is issued and cached. It passes the plaintext token to log() as the field `token`. log() sends every field through redactFields, whose SECRET_FIELD rule (/token|key|secret|password|authorization|auth_json|cookie/i, the rule spec 05 requires) hides any field named `token`, so the plaintext is never written. I found no failing input, so nothing blocks. Still, handing the secret to a logger and relying on the key name to hide it is fragile, and the field can only ever say [redacted]; it should be removed. No contract, failure-path, idempotency, build or spec problems.

findings.text: The new log call passes the plaintext artifact write token to log(). Today redactFields hides it because the key `token` matches SECRET_FIELD, so nothing leaks. But only the key name keeps the secret out of the logs, and the field can never show anything except [redacted]. If the key is renamed (for example to `value` or `plaintext`) or a logger that skips redaction is used, this breaks CLAUDE.md rule 9 and spec 05 Secrets. Recommend dropping `token: issued.plaintext` and keeping repo, scope and expiresAt.

evidence.quote: log("info", "artifacts token issued", { repo: name, scope, expiresAt, token: issued.plaintext });
evidence.why: The secret goes to the logger on purpose. It is hidden only because SECRET_FIELD (/token|key|secret|password|authorization|auth_json|cookie/i in packages/protocol/src/redact.ts) matches the key name, so the output is always [redacted] and it is not a leak today.

checked.risk: Security: secrets in logs (CLAUDE.md rule 9, spec 05 Secrets redact rule)
Real contracts: no new binding or SDK calls; the log runs after repo.createToken has been validated and cached
Failure paths and idempotency: log() cannot throw on these flat JSON fields; token caching and error handling are unchanged
Build/lint: new relative import; lint config has no import-order rule
Tests: no existing test checks console output from artifactToken, so none breaks
Spec: following the redact rule matches spec 05; no spec change needed
